Generated from [`/openapi.yaml`](/openapi.yaml) (OpenAPI 3.0.3, API version 1.0.0). The Go tests check that contract against the server's real routes, scopes, states and error codes, so this reference lists only what exists.

## Base URL

There is no central hosted endpoint. Every request goes to your own instance, `$NJIWA_MAIL_URL` (in examples `https://mail-api.example.com`).

## Conventions

- **Authentication:** `Authorization: Bearer <key>` with a sandbox (`dmk_sbx_…`) or live (`dmk_liv_…`) key, from your server only. Each endpoint lists the scope it needs. Public endpoints (forms, chat, unsubscribe, web view, health) take no key.
- **Bodies:** JSON with `Content-Type: application/json`, UTF-8. Unknown fields are rejected with `422 invalid_request`.
- **Idempotency:** `POST /v1/emails` requires an `Idempotency-Key`. Reuse it on every retry of the same event; see [Idempotency](/docs/api/idempotency).
- **Errors:** one shape, `error.code` and an optional `error.message`; see [Rate limits and errors](/docs/api/rate-limits-and-errors).
- **States:** `submitted` means your mail server accepted the message. There is no `delivered` state.

## Endpoints

### Emails

Queue, read and cancel outbound email

| Endpoint | Summary | Authentication |
|---|---|---|
| [`POST /v1/emails`](/docs/api-reference/emails/send-email) | Queue one email | `emails:send` or `emails:send_raw` |
| [`POST /v1/emails/batch`](/docs/api-reference/emails/send-batch) | Queue up to 100 emails | `emails:send` or `emails:send_raw (per item)` |
| [`GET /v1/emails/{id}`](/docs/api-reference/emails/get-email) | Read a message's status | `emails:read` |
| [`POST /v1/emails/{id}/cancel`](/docs/api-reference/emails/cancel-email) | Cancel a queued or scheduled email | `emails:send` or `emails:send_raw` |

### Inbound

Read mail received at your inbound addresses

| Endpoint | Summary | Authentication |
|---|---|---|
| [`GET /v1/inbound`](/docs/api-reference/inbound/list-inbound) | List inbound messages | `inbound:read` |
| [`POST /v1/inbound/ingest/{env}`](/docs/api-reference/inbound/ingest-inbound) | Deliver one inbound message over HTTP (signed) | public |
| [`GET /v1/inbound/{id}`](/docs/api-reference/inbound/get-inbound) | Read one inbound message | `inbound:read` |
| [`GET /v1/inbound/{id}/attachments/{aid}`](/docs/api-reference/inbound/get-inbound-attachment) | Download an inbound attachment | `inbound:read` |
